message.content:
The table `mandatory_handlers` has 255 entries (indices 0..254). `htype` is a uint8_t with range 0..255. The check `htype < 0x80` routes 0..127 to optional handling. For htype in 128..255, it indexes `mandatory_handlers[htype]`. When htype == 255, this is out of bounds (valid indices 0..254). The problem statement says handlers exist for values 0 through 254, so 255 is out of range.

The bug is the missing bounds check before indexing at line 12.

Answer: 12
